_comment: Human/tooling-facing listing of what's in Hom/plugins/. hom.exe itself doesn't read this file -- 'hom install <name>' just requests plugins/<name>.hrp directly -- this is here so people browsing the repo (or a future 'hom search') can see what's available.

plugins.name: input-overlay
plugins.description: Keyboard / mouse / gamepad input overlay presets (WASD, QWERTY, mouse, gamepad).
